title: The integrated terminal
summary: The integrated terminal is a real shell inside the editor window. Its commands can change files just like any other terminal.
introduction: The integrated terminal is a real shell inside the editor window. Its commands can change files just like any other terminal. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.title: The integrated terminal

blocks.text: The terminal is convenient but still powerful. Know which project folder it is using.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Compare the terminal path with the folder open in Explorer.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not paste an unfamiliar command just because it is shown near editor instructions.
